ModMetaData.name: New Game Plus
ModMetaData.author: Boundir
ModMetaData.description:
This mod carries your setup into every new colony, so you stop redoing the same configuration each time.
General: default gameplay, medical, production and threat response settings, applied to every new game and to bills, outfits, factions and colonists that appear while playing.
Storyteller: pre-selects the storyteller, the difficulty (including every custom difficulty setting), commitment mode and the anomaly playstyle on the new-game screen. You can still change everything before starting.
Policies: apparel, food, drug and reading policies carried into every new game. A policy that allowed everything stays open to items from mods you install later.
Areas: allowed area names and colors, recreated (empty) on the starting map.
Bills: every save captures that colony's workbench bills into a per-colony group (can be turned off in the settings). Keep your favorites in a cross-game library and import them back from any workbench's Bills tab.
Everything is stored outside your save games, in ...\AppData\LocalLow\Ludeon Studios\RimWorld by Ludeon Studios\NewGamePlus\NewGamePlusData.xml.
Note that after removing a mod that added entries in policies, you may see harmless "could not load reference" messages once.
